p.src: 1  Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

ja: イスラエルの民よ、主があなたがたに告げられたこの言葉を聞け。私がエジプトの
げた家族全体に向かって、
en: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
u.src: 1  Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

p.src: 2  “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

ja: で、 私が選んだのは、ただあなたがただけである。 それゆえ、あなたがたのすべての
en: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
u.src: 2  “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

p.src: 3  Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

ja: の者は、 互いに申し
en: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
u.src: 3  Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

p.src: 4  Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

ja: がないのに、 獅子は茂みの中でほえるだろうか。
らえていないのに、 若い獅子は巣
en: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
u.src: 4  Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

p.src: 5  Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

ja: らえていないのに、 わなが
en: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
u.src: 5  Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

p.src: 6  Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?

ja: れないことがあるだろうか。
こって、 主がそれを行われなかったことがあるだろうか。
en: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?
u.src: 6  Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?

p.src: 7  Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

ja: は、 ご自分の秘めた計画をしもべである
en: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
u.src: 7  Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

p.src: 8  The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

ja: れずにいられるだろうか。
せずにいられるだろうか。
en: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
u.src: 8  The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

p.src: 9  Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

en: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
u.src: 9  Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

p.src: 10  “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

ja: らない」 と主は言われる。 「彼らは宮殿の中に
en: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
u.src: 10  “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

p.src: 11  Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

ja: を襲い、 あなたの城塞を打ち崩し、 あなたの
en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
u.src: 11  Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

p.src: 12  The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

ja: を救い出すように、 サマリアで長椅子の隅や、 絹張りの寝台に座るイスラエルの民も、 そのように
en: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
u.src: 12  The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

p.src: 13  “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.

ja: 「聞け。そしてヤコブの家に対して証言せよ」 と
en: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
u.src: 13  “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.

p.src: 14  “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

en: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
u.src: 14  “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

p.src: 15  I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.

en: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
u.src: 15  I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
